description: This file defines the AttendanceRepository class, which manages attendance data operations such as inserting current time records and retrieving records by date or week start date. It interacts with external data sources and models to facilitate attendance tracking functionality.

classes.name: AttendanceRepository
classes.description: Repository class encapsulating attendance operations such as inserting records with current timestamp and retrieving records based on date or week start date.

methods.name: insertNow
methods.description: Inserts a new attendance record with current UTC time, student name, period, and status.

methods.name: getByDate
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records for a specific date.

methods.name: getByWeekStart
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records starting from a specified week start date.
